Barnaby has to solve an explosion as well as a number of murders near a freight company while trying to cope with his acting CS who has very strong beliefs about teamwork.

Barnaby is implicated in a murder when a photo of him in a passionate embrace with another woman is displayed shortly before the woman’s estranged photographer husband is strangled.
When a hotel owner dies, the manager misses the reading of the will that names him part-owner.
A killer strikes for real at an immersive murder mystery weekend.
